title: Phu Quoc’s October count is already 673,251 visits
summary: The culture ministry’s 21 October report says Phu Quoc took about 673,251 visits in October, up 30.3 percent, including 223,440 international visits, up 53.4 percent. Ten months have already passed the island’s plan for the year.
photoAlt: Bai Sao beach on Phu Quoc
body: October is not over, and the island has already posted a heavy month. On 21 October the Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism published An Giang’s tourism report. For the Phu Quoc special zone in October it gives about 673,251 visits, up 30.3 percent on the same month a year earlier. International visits were 223,440, up 53.4 percent. October revenue is estimated at 4,350 tỷ đồng, up 39.5 percent.

The ten-month line is the one that clears the year’s homework. From January through October the island is reported at 9,246,686 visits, up 30.4 percent, and 8.8 percent past the plan for all of 2026. International visits in those ten months were 2,146,416, up 59.4 percent and 6.4 percent past the year plan. Ten-month revenue was 50,326 tỷ đồng, up 46.9 percent and 10.6 percent past the target set for the whole year. The photograph is Bai Sao, on the island those numbers are counting.

sources.label: Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism, 21 October 2026
